rejected.description: El Prater de Viena es mucho más que un parque de atracciones 🎢 Nació en 1766 como un antiguo coto de caza de los Habsburgo y hoy es uno de los lugares más divertidos de Viena. Tucked just off the Graben in Vienna’s historic center, St. Peter’s Church (Peterskirche) is one of those places that looks impressive from the outside but becomes absolutely breathtaking once you step through the doors. The site has been associated with Christian worship since Roman-era Vienna, but the church you see today was built in the early 18th century and is considered one of Vienna’s great examples of Baroque architecture. Inside, look up. The massive dome fresco, elaborate gold details, sculptures, paintings, and ornate altar create an incredible sense of scale and detail.
